title: Pretxt Emerges Stealth With $5M Seed and an AI Supervision Tool
content_md: Pretxt , with offices in Aspen, CO, and Dublin, Ireland, has emerged from stealth with $5 million seed funding raised from Deciens Capital, Howdy Partners and Service Provider Capital. Pretxt enters the emerging category of firms providing technology to prevent AI agents escaping their guardrails and causing unintended harm. AI is more like a person than like traditional computer code: it doesn’t simply run; it receives, interprets, misinterprets and responds to ambiguous instructions. It is the combination of misinterpretation and wide agency of response that results in AI agents going rogue and potentially causing harm. Since it is impossible to categorically exclude ambiguity in language (which is how we instruct the agents), our only alternative method of controlling them is to limit their agency. But too stringent a limitation of agency could become an unacceptable restriction on a potentially huge business benefit. So, without a new category of supervision control, it is likely that we cannot have beneficial AI agents without also having potentially dangerous rogue agents. This requirement for a new control is leading to the emergence of a type of cybersecurity product that attempts to recognize a potentially harmful agentic action at runtime and control it before it can cause harm.
